sections.chapter_title: Ethernet (ETH): media access control (MAC) with DMA controller
sections.text_helper: Section 48.11.1 "Ethernet register maps" in chapter 48 (Ethernet (ETH): media access control (MAC) with DMA controller), RM0522 Rev 1, page 2280.
sections.section_content:
This section provides the following register maps:
• DMA registers (see Section48.11.2: Ethernet DMA registers)
• MTL registers (see Section48.11.3: Ethernet MTL registers)
• MAC registers including MMC registers (see Section48.11.4: Ethernet MAC and MMC
registers)
